notes: Pass if the continuous S11<=-10 dB band covering 77 GHz (nearest sweep point) has relative bandwidth 2(fH-fL)/(fH+fL) >= 0.30. Do not pass/fail on matching S11_min. Nominal must pass (~32% around 77 GHz, only ~2pp of headroom); sandbox start must fail (no -10 dB band). Budget is 8 hours of HFSS solve time only (sum of log solve_time lines); protocol.on_time is separate from RF pass. Second sitting: threshold raised 0.25 -> 0.30 and budget 4h -> 8h after the first sitting passed in 2 rounds.
